runtimeContext.description: what the host knows about the task, written by the host into the file the runtimeContextVariable names; the model never writes it

requester.description: the person the task works for

today.description: the task's date in the company's time zone, YYYY-MM-DD

company.description: per document language (ko, en), the absolute path of the company-profile.json that company_info_get kept in the task directory, its seal and logo beside it

registeredDocuments.description: each document company_document_register recorded in this task, oldest first

attachments.description: each file the person attached to the task's messages

reviewsDeckRenders.description: true when the host reviews every slide render of a delivered deck itself and repairs the slides it flags, so a deck build writes the review manifest for it

preparesDecks.description: true when the host prepares a deck when asked: it answers the typeface question of the request file the deckPreparation names in one decision call, and gathers the images the requester can use, before the next command runs

deckDesign.description: the host's answer to the deck's typeface question once the deck preparation ran, with its failure when no answer came; null until then

choices.description: per question, the option chosen and every option's probability

images.description: the data room images the requester can use in a deck, gathered as the requester when the deck preparation ran; empty until then

path.description: absolute path of the kept copy

folder.description: the data room category it is filed under

fonts.description: font files the requester can read in the data room, as the requester; a deck set in a font the person asked for finds it here, among the attachments, in the font cache or on Google Fonts

path.description: absolute path of the kept copy

judgesDraftClaims.description: true when the host judges the claims of a deck draft between commands: office check and office create write them to the draftClaims request file, and the host answers in draftClaims before the next command

draftClaims.description: the host's judgment of the last draft claims request: the draft's digest and the units the request, its attachments and the runtime facts do not support; null until a draft was judged

choosesDeckLayouts.description: true when the host chooses each outline page's layout: office check outline.json writes the deckLayouts request file, and the host answers its questions in one decision call before the next command

deckLayouts.description: the host's answers to the last deckLayouts request: the request's digest, per page question the option chosen and every option's probability, with its failure when no answer came; null until a request was answered

choices.description: per question, the option chosen and every option's probability

source.description: the snapshot an office command writes beside each file it writes, named <file><sourceSuffix>; the host delivers a new file with a deliverable extension only when this snapshot is beside it, and reads its blanks into the delivery result; the host also asks of each claim whether the request, its attachments and the runtime facts support it, and remakes the file from its snapshot with each claim it finds unsupported blank

blanks.description: every value the file leaves blank for the person to fill or send; absent when the command does not know its blanks

claims.description: every value the model composed as text: in a file drawn from a schema or a declaration, one entry per paragraph sentence, item text, owner, text cell and text field; in a deck, one per title, sentence, list item, figure, table cell, chart caption and chart

path.description: where the value sits in the given values; a sentence of a paragraph ends in #<index>

at.description: where it sits, as a person would name it

deck.description: the deck source a deck was built from, present only in a deck's snapshot

schema.description: the schema a merged document was drawn from

given.description: the values a merged document was given, as the model wrote them

tables.description: a declared workbook's source tables: each one's name, column headers and number of records

views.description: a declared workbook's views as they display: each one's title, sheet, rows of shown cell text with the header first, and the notes under it

charts.description: a declared workbook's charts as declared: the view each draws, its type and title

slides.description: a deck's slides as built from its source, in order: each one's number, layout, title, the rest of its text, its tables as rows of cell text, its charts' data and its icons; speaker notes are left out, and a value the claim check blanked is absent

visualReview.description: a deck's visual review: the absolute path of the JSON its build wrote, holding the question to ask of each slide render, the question to ask of one contact sheet of all the renders, the threshold and per-option thresholds, the rounds, the fixer's instructions and each slide's render, facts, page file (source) and its text (section), measured defects, and recompose when the claim check took text out of that page; the host writes a repaired slide's section into its source and rebuilds; absent for files that are not decks

design.description: how a deck's design was chosen: per question the option, where it came from (source, decided or fallback) and its probabilities, the brand color taken from the logo, and the images and logo the deck could use

blankCommand.description: how the host remakes a file with claims blank, run as the person: merge for a snapshot that names a schema, create for one that names a declaration or a deck; the snapshot stands in for the values or the declaration, a deck is rebuilt from its outline with each blanked unit taken out of its page and the outline, and the visual review asked to recompose those pages, and each --blank names a claim path; replaceFlag, passed as <replaceFlag> <path>=<text>, gives a claim path the text it takes instead, and a path both blanked and replaced is blanked

sourceContent.description: the snapshot fields that say what the file holds; the host reads them as the person and hands them, with the delivered file, to the check that judges the file against the request. companionFields go with them and never alone: a snapshot holding none of fields says nothing of what the file holds, so the host hands no holds for it and the check reads the file's delivery record instead

deckPreparation.description: office guide slides writes this file beside the runtime context when the host prepares decks and has not prepared this one; it names the typeface question file, whose instructions and options the host asks as one batch of choice questions with the request and the gathered images as state; the host removes the request after writing deckDesign and images into the runtime context

draftClaims.description: office check and office create write the claims of the deck draft, the outline's core hook, titles and briefs and the text of every page written so far, to requestFile beside the runtime context when the host judges drafts; before the next command the host judges them the way it judges a delivered file's claims and writes draftClaims into the runtime context; the next office check or create refuses each unit named there that the outline or a page still holds, once, and records the refused texts in reportedFile beside the context so a unit is never refused twice

deckLayouts.description: office check outline.json writes this file beside the runtime context when the host chooses deck layouts: one choice question per outline page, the page's title, brief and photo count in its instructions and the layouts its type takes as options, in the shape of the deckPreparation question file; before the next command the host asks them in one decision call with the request as state and writes deckLayouts with the sha-256 digest of the file's bytes
